errors.evidence: The countries on the horizontal axis are not listed in alphabetical order. They are sorted in ascending order based on their corresponding percentage values.
The bar for Bulgaria reaches a value very close to 60%, approximately 59%. The reported value of 57% is an underestimation.

errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect and contradictory. It falsely claims there is no arrangement other than alphabetical, when in fact the bars are clearly sorted by their values in ascending order.
The phrase "significantly higher values" is a subjective interpretation, which the prompt instructs to avoid.
This value refers to Greece. The bar for Greece is approximately at the 45% mark, not 43%.
The description claims Sweden's value is under 5%, but the bar for Sweden is at or slightly above the 5% line.
This value refers to EU28. The bar for EU28 is visibly higher than 16%, closer to 18% or 19%.
